# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Context: NO gradient this iteration
All 30 trajectories (10 tasks × 3 trials) are the SAME uncontrollable infra abort
("SPA deploy failed: SPA intervention library not found"). reward=0 on every one, zero
action_check / communicate_check signal. There is NO failing capability cluster to
diagnose. Per the focus block ("seek a robustness/generalization gain that does not
regress the solid tasks") and cand_0001's own recommendation to KEEP its safe guards,
this iteration re-applies cand_0001's validated bounded guards (its batch was reverted
because it landed UNRESOLVED, NOT refuted) and adds structurally-different safe guards so
the tool surface is stronger IF a real re-score ever lands.

## Ranked issue list
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| — | (none actionable) | all 10 = infra abort | SPA library missing on disk | INFRA (uncontrollable) | no edit can fix; do not optimize against |

Robustness targets (policy rules the API leaves UNCHECKED — verified against bench source):
| target | tool | tag | class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| >5 passengers | book_reservation | RULE | in-body guard |
| payment-method count limits (<=1 cert, <=1 cc, <=3 gift) | book_reservation | RULE | in-body guard (NEW) |
| nonfree_baggages must equal derived paid-bag count | book_reservation, update_reservation_baggages | RULE | in-body computation guard |
| checked bags cannot be removed | update_reservation_baggages | RULE | in-body guard |
| basic-economy segments cannot change | update_reservation_flights | RULE | in-body guard |
| flown flight cannot be cancelled -> transfer | cancel_reservation | RULE + KNOWLEDGE | in-body guard (NEW) + docstring |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| >5 pax | in-body guard | book_reservation.py | raises if len(passengers)>5 (policy cap; API unchecked) | fires only on >5; general |
| payment counts | in-body guard (NEW type) | book_reservation.py | classifies payment_ids by prefix; raises if >1 cert / >1 cc / >3 gift | 0 false-pos on all 2000 DB reservations |
| derived nonfree | in-body computation | book_reservation.py + update_reservation_baggages.py | raises unless nonfree==max(0,total-free_allowance), free_allowance from membership x cabin x pax | 0 mismatches on all 2000 DB reservations |
| no bag removal | in-body guard | update_reservation_baggages.py | raises if total_baggages < reservation's current total | fires only on decrease |
| basic-econ segments | in-body guard | update_reservation_flights.py | raises if cabin==basic_economy AND (flight_number,date) multiset changes; cabin-only change allowed | fires only on segment change of a BE reservation |
| flown-flight cancel | in-body guard (NEW) + enriched docstring | cancel_reservation.py | looks up each segment via env_get_flight_status; raises->transfer if any status is 'flying'/'landed'; docstring states the unchecked eligibility rules | fires only when a segment already departed (exactly when cancel is forbidden) |
| actionable errors | enriched return/error text | all four | every guard message states what's wrong + the correct value/next step | low-risk |

## Verify-the-fix (ran each body on real DB data; see harness output)
- book >5 pax: passengers=[{}]*6 -> RAISE "at most 5 passengers"; 1 pax -> passes guard.
- book payment counts: two credit_card_* ids -> RAISE "at most 1 credit card"; single card -> passes.
- book derived nonfree: regular/economy/1pax/total=3/nonfree=0 -> RAISE; nonfree=2 -> passes.
- baggages removal: total = current-1 -> RAISE "bags cannot be removed"; unchanged -> passes.
- baggages derived nonfree: silver/business add-1 wrong nonfree -> RAISE; correct nonfree -> passes.
- flights basic-econ: BE reservation, same segments + cabin change -> passes; changed segment -> RAISE; non-BE reservation changing segments -> passes (guard does NOT fire).
- cancel flown: reservation with a 'landed'/'flying' segment -> RAISE->transfer; reservation with all not-yet-flown segments -> passes.
- Blast radius: full-DB sweep = 0 nonfree mismatches and 0 payment-count violations across 2000 reservations -> derived/payment guards have an EMPTY false-positive set. All guards fire only on the exact policy-violating condition -> BOUNDED class; no passing task's gold action is altered. (Currently there are 0 passing tasks anyway - all infra - so blast radius is doubly safe.)

## Process & features used
- Serial (single agent). Grounded every rule in the real bench source:
  tau2-bench/src/tau2/domains/airline/{policy.md,tools.py} and db.json (confirmed which
  rules the primitives already enforce, to avoid redundant guards: payment-in-profile,
  certificate-for-update, gift-card balance, passenger-count-match are already enforced ->
  NOT re-guarded; the count limits, free-bag allowance, bag-removal, basic-econ segments,
  and flown-flight cancel are NOT enforced -> guarded here).
- Read ./prior_iterations/cand_0001/ (PROCESS.md + diff.patch) and RUNMAP/LEDGER/JOURNAL:
  built directly on cand_0001's guards, kept them verbatim where they were correct, and
  added the payment-count and flown-flight guards it explicitly deferred/skipped.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The six bounded guards above and the derived free-bag formula (validated 2000/2000).
- Do NOT re-guard rules the primitive already enforces (redundant, adds no signal).
- Never loosen a decision/permission rule; only encode the exact discriminating condition.

## Deliberately skipped
- All 10 tasks (8,11,12,17,19,22,23,25,37,40): pure infra aborts - uncontrollable, no edit fixes them.
- Full cancel eligibility (24h / airline-cancelled / insurance-reason): needs the cancellation
  REASON, which is not a tool argument -> cannot enforce in code without over-blocking; left as
  additive docstring KNOWLEDGE only (safe), coded guard limited to the flown-flight case which
  IS derivable from tool state.
